records.title: Conflict-of-Interest Policy (2024)
records.body:
# Conflict-of-Interest Policy (2024)

Conflict-of-interest policy of Stillwater Brook Watershed Alliance (Stillwater Brook), effective
2024-01-17.

The Board revised the policy in 2024 to require an annual written disclosure from every Trustee and from staff with purchasing authority.

## Disclosure

Each Trustee and covered staff member files a written disclosure annually and whenever a new interest arises.

## Recusal

A person with a conflict leaves the discussion and does not vote on the matter.


The Board reviews this policy and each trustee's disclosure annually. Earlier
versions remain in the vault marked `superseded`.

records.title: Bylaws (2024)
records.body:
# Bylaws (2024)

Bylaws of Stillwater Brook Watershed Alliance, a Massachusetts nonprofit corporation, effective
2024-03-20.

The Board amended and restated the bylaws in 2024 to add a conflict-of-interest article and to fix the number of Trustees at seven.

## Article I — Purpose

To protect the land and water of the watershed through conservation, stewardship, and education.

## Article II — Board of Trustees

The Board consists of seven Trustees elected at the annual meeting.

## Article III — Conflicts of Interest

Trustees and staff follow the conflict-of-interest policy, reviewed annually.


The current bylaws are the most recent version in this chain. Earlier versions
remain in the vault marked `superseded`; they are never deleted.

records.title: Is the Lower Brook Trail open?
records.body:
# Is the Lower Brook Trail open?

Usually. It closes during high water, which the river sensors detect. Check the status page for the live trail status before you visit.

records.title: What do the river sensors measure?
records.body:
# What do the river sensors measure?

Water level and temperature at two gauges, read every fifteen minutes. Level drives the high-water trail-closure protocol; temperature feeds the water-quality monitoring partnership.

The local Conservation Commission issued an Order of Conditions permitting repair of the Lower Brook footbridge under the Wetlands Protection Act. Work was completed within the conditions.

records.title: Can I hold an event at the preserve?
records.body:
# Can I hold an event at the preserve?

Small gatherings are welcome on the trails. Organized events and anything with amplified sound or vehicles need advance permission; ask through the website.

records.title: How do I report a downed tree or a trail hazard?
records.body:
# How do I report a downed tree or a trail hazard?

Use the report form on the website. Note the trail and roughly where you saw it. Staff and stewardship volunteers check reports through the week.

records.title: How do I donate land or a conservation easement?
records.body:
# How do I donate land or a conservation easement?

Start a conversation through the website. The Stewardship Coordinator will walk you through what the alliance can accept and what stewardship commitment an easement carries.

records.title: What does a conservation easement allow?
records.body:
# What does a conservation easement allow?

It depends on the easement's terms, which run with the land. In general easements limit development while allowing continued stewardship and, where the terms say so, public access. The specific easement record governs.

# July 2026 board meeting agenda

Agenda for the Wednesday, July 15, 2026 meeting of the Stillwater Brook Board of
Trustees.

1. Call to order and roll call
2. Approval of the prior meeting's minutes
3. Staff and committee reports
4. Water-quality monitoring partnership

# July 2026 board meeting notice

Stillwater Brook Watershed Alliance (Stillwater Brook) gives notice of a public meeting of its
Board of Trustees.

- **Meeting:** Wednesday, July 15, 2026
- **Time:** 7:00 p.m.
- **Place:** the Watershed Visitor Center, Route 9
- **Attending:** open to the public; remote-participation details are posted at

approves them at a later meeting. When this notice was posted is recorded in the

record does not assert that itself.

records.title: Board meeting minutes, 2026-08-19
records.body:
# Board meeting minutes, 2026-08-19

Minutes of the Wednesday, August 19, 2026 meeting of the Stillwater Brook Board of
Trustees. Approved by the Board on 2026-09-16.

**Present:** 7 of 7 trustees. Staff present: Executive Director; the Outreach Coordinator.

## Approval of prior minutes

The minutes of the previous regular meeting were reviewed and approved as circulated.

## Staff and committee reports

The outreach coordinator summarized operations since the last meeting, including visitor-center attendance and the status of the river-sensor network. The Stewardship Committee reported on easement monitoring visits completed during the period.

## Business

- The Board discussed the annual appeal and the draft operating budget.
- The Board discussed a grant application to the state Division of Ecological Restoration.

## Votes

- Motion on the annual appeal and the draft operating budget: carried 5–2.
- Motion on a grant application to the state Division of Ecological Restoration: carried 5–0.


The meeting adjourned at 8:45 p.m.. These minutes were approved at the
following regular meeting and posted after that approval.

records.title: How do I volunteer?
records.body:
# How do I volunteer?

The alliance runs stewardship workdays and visitor-center shifts through the season. Sign up through the website; no experience is needed.

records.title: Fall trail conditions and sensor update
records.body:
# Fall trail conditions and sensor update

All trails are open. The Route 9 and Cedar Marsh river sensors were serviced this month and are reporting normally.

Posted by Stillwater Brook. Current trail and visitor-center status is kept
up to date at https://stillwaterbrook.example.org/status.

# Notice of regular board meeting, October 17, 2026

The board of directors will meet on Friday, October 17, 2026 at 6:30 pm at the visitor center, 14 Mill Road. The agenda includes the fall stewardship report, the 2027 budget draft, and public comment.
